item_name: Rothco Canvas Pocketed Military Gear Bag
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Canvas Pocketed Gear Bag is designed to offer maximum storage and organization for all your essentials. Constructed from 100% durable canvas, this bag features 8 front pockets, 2 side pockets, and a spacious main compartment with a U-shaped zipper for easy access to all your gear. The main compartment measures 25.5 inches x 11.5 inches x 13 inches, providing ample space for larger items, while the left side pocket with zippered closure and open right side pocket offer additional storage for smaller necessities.
description: Rothco’s Canvas Pocketed Gear Bag is designed to offer maximum storage and organization for all your essentials. Constructed from 100% durable canvas, this bag features 8 front pockets, 2 side pockets, and a spacious main compartment with a U-shaped zipper for easy access to all your gear. The main compartment measures 25.5 inches x 11.5 inches x 13 inches, providing ample space for larger items, while the left side pocket with zippered closure and open right side pocket offer additional storage for smaller necessities. The bag also includes a 53 inch detachable and adjustable shoulder strap with a padded 7 inch shoulder pad for comfortable carrying, as well as 2 carry handles with a hook and loop fold-over closure. With its durable construction and functional design, this canvas gear bag is perfect for travel, work, or outdoor activities. Made from Rothco’s durable heavyweight canvas fabric, this superior material is naturally water-resistant, rugged, and is built for the long haul. No one comes close to Rothco’s collection of ultra-premium canvas bags and packs.
